block_native_baseline.proof: drift = -dose for every non-brightening gain on nonnegative inputs, independently of noise model

identifiability.additional_observation: independent same-pose high-sample native physical D/S reference with controlled known illumination intervention, or a certified external illumination-change interval; neither is packaged
identifiability.bound: For observations X=aR: preserving true light requires gain=1; removing excess requires gain=1/a. No deterministic or randomized function of identical observations can guarantee both.

sparse_sampling.claim_scope: synthetic static single-spike 8x8 cell, no D3D sampler precision issue at exact half fractions; not a claim that captured residual is pure path noise

full_resolution_boundary.scope: ideal bilinear CPU scalar Apply; hardware sampler parity is a separate local gate
